rationale: Both responses apply w = c + e^{i pi/4}(z - c), compute z - c = sqrt(2)(1 - 3i) and simplify (1+i)(1-3i) to 4 - 2i, giving w = 6 - 5i. B breaks the subtraction into real and imaginary parts, though it loosely says the real parts 'cancel' when they leave sqrt(2). A does the subtraction in one line. Both are correct and clear, with no meaningful difference in the quality of the reasoning.
